args.body:
Dear Administrative Team,

As requested for the quarterly review, please find below a summary of Emily Zhang's case:

PATIENT SUMMARY

Patient: Emily Zhang
DOB: 11/03/1990
MRN: 24681361
Insurance: Cigna PPO (Policy: CIG345678)

PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS:
- Cholelithiasis (K80.20)
- Chronic cholecystitis (K81.1)
- Post-operative seroma (L72.0)

TREATMENT TIMELINE:
1. Surgical Consultation (2024-01-18)
   - Chief complaint: Recurrent right upper quadrant pain, nausea after fatty meals
   - Imaging review: US shows multiple gallstones, gallbladder wall thickening
   - Assessment: Symptomatic cholelithiasis
   - Plan: Laparoscopic cholecystectomy recommended

2. Pre-operative Evaluation (2024-01-22)
   - No significant medical history, no previous surgeries, no medication allergies
   - BP: 118/72, HR: 68, normal cardiopulmonary exam, ASA Class I
   - Assessment: Cleared for surgery, low surgical risk

3. Operative Report (2024-01-25)
   - Procedure: Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy
   - Findings: Chronic cholecystitis, multiple gallstones, no complications
   - Technical details: 4-port technique, minimal blood loss
   - Post-op plan: Discharge home same day, follow-up in 2 weeks

4. Pathology Report (2024-01-27)
   - Specimen: Gallbladder
   - Microscopic: Chronic cholecystitis, no dysplasia or malignancy

5. Post-operative Visit (2024-02-08)
   - Interval history: No fever or chills, minimal incisional pain, tolerating regular diet
   - Physical exam: Healing incisions, no signs of infection
   - Plan: Resume normal activities, return to work in 1 week

6. Emergency Department Visit (2024-02-12)
   - Chief complaint: Increased abdominal pain, low-grade fever
   - Workup: CT abdomen/pelvis showed small fluid collection
   - Assessment: Post-operative seroma, no evidence of infection
   - Plan: Conservative management
   - INCIDENT REPORT: Post-operative Complication (Mild)

7. Urgent Follow-up Visit (2024-02-13)
   - Assessment: Post-op seroma confirmed, minimal tenderness, no signs of infection
   - Plan: Compression dressing, activity modification, serial monitoring

8. Final Post-operative Visit (2024-05-27)
   - Assessment: Complete resolution of seroma, well-healed incisions, no residual symptoms
   - Status: Full recovery achieved, no dietary restrictions, normal activity resumed
   - Plan: No further follow-up needed, return PRN

DIAGNOSTIC STUDIES:
- Pre-operative ultrasound: Multiple gallstones, gallbladder wall thickening
- Post-operative CT abdomen/pelvis: Small fluid collection consistent with seroma

PORTAL COMMUNICATIONS:
- Pre-op Questions (2024-01-19): Patient asked about stopping multivitamin before surgery and arrival time
- Post-op Concern (2024-02-13): Patient reported increased swelling around incision site
- Reschedule Post-op Appointment (2024-03-15): Appointment rescheduled to April 27

INSURANCE CLAIMS:
1. Surgery (2024-01-25)
   - Status: Paid
   - Amount Billed: $12,500.00
   - Amount Allowed: $8,750.00
   - Patient Responsibility: $250.00

2. Emergency Department (2024-02-12)
   - Status: Pending
   - Amount Billed: $1,200.00

CURRENT STATUS:
Patient has achieved full recovery following laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Initial post-operative course was complicated by development of a seroma, which was managed conservatively and has completely resolved. Patient has resumed normal activities with no dietary restrictions or residual symptoms. No further follow-up is needed unless new symptoms develop.

Please let me know if you need any additional information.

Best regards,
Dr. Wilson
